    • Method Detail

      • detect

        public static SpreadsheetFileDetector.DetectionResult detect(java.nio.file.Path fpath)
                                                      throws java.io.IOException
        Detects XLS, XLSX, and ODS spreadsheet formats by examining file contents.

        The detection process follows these steps:

        1. Identifies legacy XLS files by checking for the OLE container signature and determining the BIFF version of the contained workbook stream.
        2. Identifies ZIP-based spreadsheet formats by inspecting their internal structures to distinguish ODS from XLSX packages.
        3. Returns an unknown format if no supported spreadsheet format is identified.
        Parameters:
        fpath - path to the spreadsheet file
        Returns:
        the detection result, including the detected format, BIFF version, and workbook validation status
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - if an I/O error occurs while inspecting the file or validating the workbook

      • detectBiffVersion

        private static SpreadsheetFileDetector.BiffVersion detectBiffVersion(java.nio.file.Path fpath)
                                                              throws java.io.IOException
        Identifies the BIFF version of an Excel workbook by examining the first record in its OLE workbook stream.
        Parameters:
        fpath - path to the Excel file
        Returns:
        the detected BIFF version, or SpreadsheetFileDetector.BiffVersion.UNKNOWN if the workbook stream is missing or its BIFF version cannot be identified
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - if an I/O error occurs while reading the file

      • detectBiff5Or8

        private static SpreadsheetFileDetector.BiffVersion detectBiff5Or8(java.io.InputStream input)
                                                           throws java.io.IOException
        Reads the BOF version field following the four-byte record header.
        Parameters:
        input - starting stream positioned at the BOF record payload
        Returns:
        the detected BIFF5 or BIFF8 version, or SpreadsheetFileDetector.BiffVersion.UNKNOWN if the version field is truncated or unrecognised
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - if an I/O error occurs while reading the stream
